question: #12496 at 76db5b31 against 851a97e1: do Opacity and Rating keep one track length at every value and during a mouse drag, in every bundled theme body font, with the other sliders unchanged?

method.conditions: light and dark (Storybook global colorMode and the page color scheme) x LTR and RTL (global direction)

sliders.Rating: core-slider--text-value-widths: 1 to 5, the words Bad, Not good, Okay, Good, Great

method.storiesNote: each story as published, on both builds; the story file is the same at both commits
method.fonts: each theme's own fonts.css faces for its body family, injected as data URLs (Storybook loads no theme font); default (as served) injects nothing
method.values: Home, then ArrowUp to the end, reading the track after each step; a range sweeps the upper thumb, then the lower one
method.drag: a real mouse drag: press on the thumb, move past one end of the track in 40 steps, then past the other end in 80 steps, release; the track is read on every animation frame
method.track: the width of the slider control element (.astryx-slider-control)
method.clipped: the value text's box scrolls, or its glyphs pass its box by more than 0.5 px
